title: Outline leaves Appearance, and an effect's colour lives in its settings
goal: Border is now something you add in Effects, but the old Outline row is still sitting in Appearance, so there are two ways to draw a line round a shape and no way to tell which one you are looking at. Take Outline out. And an effect's colour should be a setting under that effect, alongside its width and position, set the way every other colour in the app is set, with saved colours available. Today the border's colour sits up in the row header, which is neither where its own settings are nor how colours work anywhere else.
notes: Reported by the user on 2026-09-07 after border-is-an-effect-you-can-add-and-shadow-is-on shipped. That task added BorderEffect (Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerEffects.swift) with a colour, width and position, but left LayerPart.outline in place, which is exactly the duplication its own acceptance asked to settle in user words; it was not settled, so settle it now by retiring the outline. The migration is the careful part, since the outline is the only edge older documents have: convert it on open rather than dropping it, and prove with a test that the picture is unchanged. On the colour: the row header currently carries the effect's colour swatch beside the tick (EffectsListInspector.swift around line 98), while its width and position sit in the settings below, so the colour is the only setting in the wrong place. Move it into the settings and use the same colour control the rest of the panel uses so saved colours work, since a colour that cannot take a style is the odd one out.
acceptance: Appearance no longer carries an Outline row, and a shape's edge is drawn only by borders added in Effects
A document saved with an outline opens with the same picture: it arrives as a border in the Effects list, and the audit says how that conversion was done
An effect's colour is a row under that effect with its own settings, not a swatch in the row header, and the row header carries only the name, the tick and the controls that act on the whole effect
The colour row behaves exactly like every other colour in the app, including using and saving named colours
Every effect that has a colour follows this, not only the border, so the list reads one way
Core logic covered by tests in PhotonzCore written before the change, including a document with an old outline opening unchanged
Audit written under queue/audits/ with a shape whose outline became a border, and an effect with its colour row open, anything rough filed as a follow-up

log.note: Adversarial review, on the probe (Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/outline-repro-walk.json, Screen Recording granted). (1) The duplication is real: a rectangle shows Appearance > Outline (colour, Width 4pt, Position Inside) AND Effects > Border (colour, Position Outside, Width 2pt), two identical questions in two panels. (2) The Outline row's colour has the saved-colours menu; the Border row's colour has none, and it sits in the row header rather than in the effect's settings beside Width and Position. (3) BLOCKER for retiring Outline: a Border effect draws a ROUNDED RECT round the layer box, never the shape's path. An ellipse with its outline off and one added Border comes out as a black SQUARE ring round a red ellipse (/tmp/photonz-playtest/outline-repro/3-canvas-ellipse-border.png). So 'a shape's edge is drawn only by borders added in Effects' cannot be true today without teaching the ring to follow the shape.

Scope call: this task is two independent changes. The colour half (acceptance 3, 4, 5) is decidable and I am building it now. The Outline half (acceptance 1, 2) needs the ellipse blocker fixed first, and it raises a question only the user can answer: with Outline gone, does a freshly drawn shape arrive with a Border already in its Effects list, or bare? Retiring the outline also touches ~150 borderWidth call sites and 55 test files, so it is not one runner iteration either way.

SHIPPED (df8b637d): the colour half. An effect's colour is now a Color row in the effect's own settings, above Position and Width, with the same well, saved-colours menu, Save as Style and name field every other colour row has. The row header carries only the name, the tick, the grip and the cross. Both the border and the shadow follow it, so the list reads one way, and a blur brings no colour row rather than a blank one. Underneath: ColorStyleBinding gained an optional effectIndex; Layer.insertEffect/removeEffect/moveEffect are now the only ways the list may change, so a name rides the row it is on; ColorSlot gained a .shadow case no layer lists among its own slots. Also fixed: the link-break notice tells a layer's border ring from an added border's colour and stays quiet when you take an effect out; a colour dropped on a switched-off effect row keeps the name it arrived under; the playtest panelMenu step takes an `in`. 18 new core tests, Scripts/test.sh green at 4724. Verified on the probe: Scripts/playtest/effect-colour-walk.json.

BLOCKED on the outline half. Acceptance 1 and 2 need a decision only the user can make: with Outline gone, does a freshly drawn shape arrive with a Border already in its Effects list, or bare? That changes what pressing R gives you every time. Decision opened with a brief at queue/decisions/outline-leaves-appearance-and-an-effect-s-colour-with-outline-gone-from-appearanc.md. It is also blocked on a reproduced bug filed as its own task: a Border draws a rounded rectangle round the layer box, so one added to an ellipse comes out as a square ring (a-border-you-add-to-an-ellipse-follows-the-ellip).
Audit for the shipped half: queue/audits/2026-09-08-effect-colour.json, with three real screen captures (Screen Recording was granted).

The colour half shipped (df8b637d) and is audited. The outline half needs one answer only the user can give: with Outline gone, does a freshly drawn shape arrive with a Border already listed, or bare? Decision opened with a brief. It also waits on a reproduced bug, filed separately: a Border draws a rectangle round the box, so one added to an ellipse comes out square.

decision "With Outline gone from Appearance, what should drawing a shape give you?" resolved: Shapes arrive with their edge already listed (The user said again on 2026-09-08 that Outline is no longer needed since borders are effects. Option a is the one that removes it with no change to what a drawn shape looks like: the edge is still there, listed as a Border you can retune, reorder or remove. If they would rather shapes arrive bare, that is a one line change afterwards.)
